picks.excerpt: The Skala model is now available, giving researchers an AI-based exchange-correlation functional for quantum mechanical simulations.
picks.rationale: A shipped, usable release: Microsoft's Skala functional lands inside CP2K, so any DFT user can swap in an AI exchange-correlation functional tomorrow.

picks.excerpt: Researchers have used AI to uncover the DNA signature of a key genetic “switch” involved in turning genes on. After analyzing about 500,000 DNA sequences, the model identified the initiator in roughly 60% of human genes. The breakthrough could help predict the effects of harmful mutations and eventu
picks.rationale: A concrete genomics finding — an AI model reading 500,000 sequences pins down the initiator element in ~60% of human genes, giving mutation-effect prediction a real anchor.

picks.excerpt: Washington State University researchers used artificial intelligence to find a more efficient, less expensive way to 3D-print a high-performance metal alloy, saving researchers from needing to painstakingly test more than 100 million options.
picks.rationale: Materials search collapsed from 100 million candidate print settings to a working recipe — the clearest example this cycle of AI replacing brute-force lab iteration.

picks.excerpt: MIT engineers developed a tool that predicts plausible extreme events and worst-case scenarios—such as an extreme storm's likely duration, intensity and area of impact—without needing data on previous extremes.
picks.rationale: MIT's method predicts worst-case extremes without ever having seen one, attacking the data-scarcity problem that has blocked climate and risk modeling.
